headline_marked: High Court [[grants ex-Chief Justice Khairul Haque bail]] in murder case
headline: High Court grants ex-Chief Justice Khairul Haque bail in murder case
summary: The court has issued a rule asking the government to explain why he should not be granted permanent bail in the case filed over a killing in Jatrabari.
details: The High Court has granted ad-interim bail to former chief justice ABM Khairul Haque in a murder case, allowing for his release from jail.
The court, consisting of Justice KM Zahid Sarwar and Justice Sheikh Abu Taher, issued a rule asking the government to explain why Khairul Haque should not be granted permanent bail.
The case was filed with Jatrabari Police Station over a killing that occurred on August 5, 2024.
Khairul Haque was arrested at his Dhanmondi residence on July 24 last year, following the fall of the Awami League government.

He was later shown arrested in multiple cases, including those related to killings during the July uprising and allegations of manipulating the Supreme Court verdict on the caretaker government system.
His lawyer, Md Motaher Hossain Sazu, stated that there is no longer a legal bar to his release from jail following the High Court order.
caption:

Khairul Haque was arrested at his Dhanmondi residence on July 24 last year, following the fall of the Awami League government.

He was later shown arrested in multiple cases, including those related to killings during the July uprising and allegations of manipulating the Supreme Court verdict on the caretaker government system.
